thread:
Maya: Quick async check — what I did: updated the content calendar for launch week (rows for May 4-8), uploaded benchmark assets to S3 (s3://redwood-marketing/bench/launch-x), and ran an image compression pass.
Maya: Blockers: need eng to confirm final model benchmark numbers for the hero blog (latency / cost) and a quick CR on the microcopy. Today: sync with design at 14:00. Can someone from eng confirm the numbers? @Sam @Priya

Sam: On it — I'll pull the perf numbers from the staging cluster and CSV export. ETA ~45m. Ping me if you need p50, p99, or tokens/sec specifically.

Jorge: Also can someone sanity-check the benchmark post copy? I trimmed some claims to be conservative. @Elle PTAL when you have a sec.

Priya: Re CRs — I'm queued to review two PRs (content-metrics, microcopy). I'll prioritize the microcopy CR first. @Maya drop the PR link here and I'll take it.

Maya: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/342 — microcopy tweaks, 3 small lines. Also pasting the draft hero benchmark snippet (DO NOT PUBLISH until Sam confirms):
```
Median latency: 28ms | 99th percentile: 120ms | Tokens/sec: ~1500
```

Sam: Confirmed on a quick query against the run: median=27.9ms, p99=118ms, tps=1523. I'm exporting the raw CSV and Grafana screenshot now. Will add the CSV to the S3 folder in ~10m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Snapshot of perf dashboard saved to https://dashboards.redwood/perf/snapshots/1769532100

Priya: Thanks Sam — I'll wait for the CSV then merge the microcopy PR. Quick question for eng infra: are the sample logs for that run in S3 or internal storage? @Sam

Sam: Logs are in s3://redwood-infra/logs/perf/1769532100.tar.gz; permissions set to marketing-team and eng. If you can't access, tell me and I'll adjust ACLs.

Elle: Copy reads well to me. Good call to soften the claim to 'typical median latency 28ms' instead of 'guaranteed'.

Jorge: Scheduling note — marketing standup moved to 10:30 tomorrow. Also we need a CTA for the bench post. Options: 'See the full benchmark' vs 'Explore performance in your region'. Thoughts?

Maya: Leaning toward 'See the full benchmark' — clearer landing. I'll A/B test 'Explore performance' on the metadata. 

Maya: Also quick ops ask: who can sign off on the CDN canary tomorrow morning? @eng-sre? @Priya are you able to coordinate?

Priya: I can coordinate the canary with eng-sre but need a 30m heads-up before we kick it off. @deploy-bot can we schedule a reminder?

deploy-bot: Canary notification scheduled for 2026-03-18T09:30:00Z to #eng-oncall and @Priya (notification sent).

Maya: lol ignore the bot typo earlier. @Priya thanks. Last quick ask: can someone do a final SEO/title pass on the hero header? Just 1-2 line tweaks.

Elle: I can do a quick SEO pass by EOD and push suggestions into the doc.

Jorge: Thanks everyone — once Sam uploads the CSV we'll lock the hero numbers and ship the bench post to staging for a final look.

Maya: Appreciated — tagging this as done-once-CSV-arrives. :white_check_mark:

Sam: CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/bench/launch-x/1769532100-perf.csv and attached to the PR. Leaving a short comment on the PR with the Grafana link.

Priya: Merged microcopy PR after CSV check. Will send a final note when the staging page is live for QA.

Maya: Perfect — I'll queue the marketing checklist and set the promotion time. Thanks all!
